pr_title: Add test cases for nulls and wrong types to aggregation tests
pr_body:
- Migrated the anyNullIsNull and wrong types cases to `AbstractFunctionTestCase`
- Minor fixes on anyNullIsNull to work with multi-row values. Just some conditions to return a List of null instead of a null. Everything else in these functions was mostly untouched
- Implemented it in some aggregations
- Fixed some errors around the aggregation tests code

Not all aggregations were migrated. Many of them have edge cases that don't work with some of those things.
For example, if `WEIGHTED_AVG(value, weight)` has a literal on the value, it ignores the weight, which makes anyNullIsNull fail as it expects a null return.
Such cases can be handled later.

Closes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/109917
pr_comments:
> For example, if `WEIGHTED_AVG(value, weight)` has a literal on the value, it ignores the weight, which makes anyNullIsNull fail as it expects a null return.

:+1:

I've noticed that sometimes we use `NULL` to mean "optional parameter not provided" but sometimes if you *do* provide it and it is `NULL` then we fail in fun ways. Just something to look out for when you are poking these.

issue_context.title: ESQL: Add abstract test cases for aggregation functions
issue_context.body:
Scalar functions have the `AbstractFunctionTestCase`, which adds a ton of automatic testing to them.
Aggregation functions currently have none. They just have some tests for the Aggregators themselves, but they aren't very "complete", and they don't cover the function as a whole (So an aggregator could not be being called at all).

We should have a similar test coverage for aggregators as we have for scalars.

- [x] Add base class for aggregation tests (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/110042)
- [x] Add tests for simple input+output
- [x] Add tests for intermediate states (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/110279)
- [x] Add test case generators for no rows (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/110279)
- [x] Add helpers to use `intCases()` (And similar) methods (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/110327)
- [x] Skip testcases with complex surrogates (E.g. mix of functions) (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/110579)
- [x] Add tests for grouping aggregators (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/110795)
- [x] Add test case generators for wrong types, like with scalar functions

review_comments: These tests were copied from Top(). But they don't make sense here, they don't add any special case. So I'm removing to simplify things a bit

This was never being called, it would be failing otherwise. So I moved here the testFold() logic, and now anything getting here must be foldable.
If a case arise where this evaluation is required, we can recover it. But for now it's meaningless

Looks like this is what the `LongBlockHash` `SeenGroupIds` is doing (more or less), and was needed to fix the tests for Max/Min.

It is now working, and I think it makes sense. But will need a double check here

`SeenGroupIds` is a kind of to handle the cases where you start off receiving no `null` values and then start receiving `null` values later. That case is fun and maybe we should get there some day. We have tests for it over in the compute engine. Maybe these tests can get there soon and we can replace them. Not sure. But this is fine for now.
This will be migrated when https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/111468 is merged
